values.note: 15 individual sites (12 RV/tent, 3 tent-only) plus 2 group tent sites. Short gravel spurs per BLM's campground map: 25 ft at sites 1, 3, 4 and 7; 20 ft at 2, 5, 6, 10 and 13; 17 ft at 12 and 14; 15 ft at 15. One RV or trailer per site, 6 people and 2 vehicles.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/penitente-canyon-campground ('15 Individual sites (3 Tent Only and 12 RV/Tent), 2 Group Tent sites, 1 CG Host site'; campground map 'RV, Parking length': 1 25', 2 20', 3 25', 4 25', 5 20', 6 20', 7 25', 10 20', 12 17', 13 20', 14 17', 15 15') + recreation.gov catalog 261713 (Driveway Length 1/3/4 25, 2/5/6/10/13 20, 12/14 17, 15 15; all back-in, no pull-through; Max Num of People 6, Max Num of Vehicles 2) + notice ('Only 1 RV/trailer per RV campsite'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Five vault toilets, trash bins, well water typically May-October (bring your own in case the well is down); table, tent pad, fire ring and food locker at each site. Spotty cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/penitente-canyon-campground ('Public drinking water system (available May-Oct).'; '5 vault (or pit-type) toilets.'; 'Trash bins throughout campground'; 'table, tent pads, fire ring, food storage locker, parking'; 'Cell phone service is spotty in canyons.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov. A no-show's site is released at 1 p.m. the next day. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/penitente-canyon-campground ('Make your reservation today at recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261713 (notice 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days.'; 'If the reservation holder doesn't show up on the first day of the reservation, the campsite is released at check-in time (1 pm) the next day.') + catalog (every site 'Site-Specific', reservable), read 2026-10-28

note: BLM campground in the Penitente Canyon Recreation Area, known for sport climbing, singletrack and pictographs, ~7,930 ft in the San Luis Valley northwest of Del Norte: from US-285, 6 miles west on Saguache County Road G past the La Garita Trading Post, left fork onto CR 38A, entrance 0.5 mile on the right; gravel roads inside. Spurs are short: only four take a 25-ft rig, so a 23-ft motorhome has little room to spare. --Claude
summary: BLM page + rec.gov + catalog + BLM's spur-length map: confirmed $11, no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov, year-round. Changed count 11->15 (BLM: 15 individual sites, 12 RV/tent). Added max 25 ft (BLM map), no pull-throughs, water/sewer false, vault toilets, seasonal well water, 14-day limit. Note rewritten with the directions and the short-spur caveat; field facts removed.
flags: Phone 719-852-7074 confirmed: BLM San Luis Valley Field Office, Monte Vista (BLM page 'Contact Us' and recreation.gov facility phone). No campground-specific line.

RIG-LENGTH (no criteria problem, thin margin): BLM does not single the campground out with 'small RVs'/'tents' wording; it publishes per-site spur lengths instead, which outrank wording. BLM's map: 25 ft at sites 1, 3, 4, 7; 20 ft at 2, 5, 6, 10, 13; 17 ft at 12, 14; 15 ft at 15. So 4 public sites take a 23-ft rig per BLM (3 per recreation.gov, which books site 7 as TENT ONLY with driveway 0 - conflict between BLM's map and the catalog on site 7). A 25-ft spur leaves ~2 ft for EKKO. A review search found no dated 2023+ review of a 23-ft+ rig in a named site (a Roadtrippers reviewer mentions a 31-ft RV, undated and no site; a Campendium reviewer says some sites take rigs under 30 ft) - nothing quotable.

Site 7 conflict: BLM map shows site 7 as RV, 25 ft; recreation.gov catalog lists 7 as TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC (driveway length 0). BLM text says 3 tent-only + 12 RV/tent, which matches the map (tent-only 8, 9, 11), so the catalog looks wrong on 7.

Road: BLM directions are Saguache CR G 6 miles from US-285, then the left fork onto CR 38A for 0.5 mile; 'Improved gravel roads in Recreation Area (no pavement)'. No 4WD/high-clearance or big-rig warning from BLM; a Campendium reviewer mentions washboard. No road-condition notice found.

Pin 37.84181,-106.28002 (BLM/recreation.gov coordinate) is at the entrance/fee area on the east end, ~369 m from the 17 catalog site points' centroid (37.84188,-106.28422), ~87 m from site 2. Under the ~500 m threshold; the RV sites 5-15 are 350-470 m west.
Waterfront not waterfront: no water at the campground (dry canyon). Unchanged.

recreation.gov rules carry reservationCutOff 0 'Not Reservable', but every site is Site-Specific and reservable, and BLM points to recreation.gov for reservations; no fcfs statement, so fcfs left unset.
Status: no closure or alert found; open year-round.
